title: Estimations / Edges and dependencies
description: Is it us or them? The client-facing Api, the signed callbacks and every external system.

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Built by Tempo from the traces. Edges are HTTP calls and Rebus messages; red marks failed calls.

panels.title: Rejected callbacks (1h)
panels.description: Callbacks refused with a 4xx: bad or missing signature or traceparent. Usually a changed signing key or a forged call.

panels.title: Api requests by route and status
Calls to external systems
panels.description: From Tempo's service graph, so each external system shows by name.

panels.title: Failed calls to external systems
panels.description: Failures after the HTTP retries end as UnableTo… messages in the saga.

targets.expr: (sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{server=~"external-.*", client!="user"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{server=~"external-.*", client!="user"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, client, server) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_bucket{server=~"external-.*", client!="user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Callbacks from external systems
panels.description: The external image and estimation services call the Api back about 10 s after accepting the work. Counted by the Api, by route and status: the external systems don't join our traces, so Tempo can't draw these edges.

panels.title: Outgoing HTTP responses by status
panels.description: HTTP/1.1 calls only: this leaves out the telemetry export to the collector and the gRPC state query, which both use HTTP/2. Includes each retry attempt.

panels.title: Requests sent
panels.description: Images imageprocessor asked external-imageprocess for (one per image analysis, whatever the retries).

panels.title: Accepted
panels.description: external-imageprocess answered with a success, possibly after HTTP retries.

panels.title: Refused after retries
panels.description: Still failing after the HTTP retries (or no answer within the timeouts): the saga gets UnableToAnalyseImage.

panels.title: Callbacks received
panels.description: Callbacks from external-imageprocess that the Api accepted (valid signature), including duplicates.

panels.title: Callbacks never received
panels.description: Accepted images whose callback didn't arrive before the saga stopped waiting: lost by external-imageprocess or rejected by the Api.

panels.title: Callbacks ignored
panels.description: Callbacks for work that already had its result (a duplicate) or had stopped waiting (too late). The saga logs and ignores each one.

panels.title: Chaos scenario of external-imageprocess
panels.description: What the external system was told to do, from its own chaos_scenario_active metric. A real external system wouldn't tell us; here it explains the panels below.

targets.expr: (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="flaky"}) * 1) + (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="slow"}) * 2) + (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="down"}) * 3) + (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="lost-callbacks"}) * 4) + (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="duplicate-callbacks"}) * 5) + (max(chaos_scenario_active{service_name="external-imageprocess", chaos_scenario="custom"}) * 6)

panels.title: Our calls vs callbacks from external-imageprocess
panels.description: Each call imageprocessor makes that external-imageprocess accepts (2xx) should come back later as one callback. If the dashed callbacks line stays below the calls line, callbacks are getting lost; if it goes above, they are duplicated. Callbacks arrive after the time the image analysis takes, so the dashed line trails the solid one a little. Red series are calls that failed or got no answer (no callback will come for those); orange series are callbacks the Api rejected (401 means a bad or expired signature).

panels.title: Call latency to external-imageprocess (p95)
panels.description: Per attempt, as our worker measures it: the network and the time external-imageprocess takes to answer.

panels.title: Round trip of each image analysis
panels.description: Per minute: requested by the saga, accepted or refused by external-imageprocess, result received through the callback, and never called back.

panels.title: Time waiting for external-imageprocess
panels.description: Per case: from the first analysis request until every image of the case has its result (or timed out). Normally about 10 s; the saga stops waiting after about 2 minutes.
